summary:
ROUND 2 (client bug 21:15): "the option to capture the audio appears, but the app receives no sound". The client added: "it records my microphone, but it has to take the video's sound".

**Causes found, by measurement:**
1. **Computer.** The direct-capture route was only a secondary "Pestaña" that called getDisplayMedia without preferCurrentTab. Chrome hides the current tab by default, so the tab playing the official player could not be picked: the user got another tab or a screen, i.e. silence. The visible primary action was the microphone, which is what the client saw being recorded.
   - Proof: with Chrome's auto-select switch, the take never started on 'Pauta' and did start on another tab.
   - Once Pauta's own tab is captured, the embedded YouTube iframe's sound does reach the stream. Isolated probe: RMS 0.17 to 0.22. This holds whether the capture starts before or after the video, and with or without stopping the video track, which the recorder does.
   - The player was never muted (isMuted false).
2. **Phone.** No browser can capture an embedded player's audio, nor another app's (Android Chrome has no getDisplayMedia). The microphone is the only live route there, and the UI did not say so.

**Fix:**
- engine-audio: additive RecorderOptions.preferCurrentTab. In tab mode it adds preferCurrentTab: true, selfBrowserSurface: 'include' and surfaceSwitching: 'include', so a single confirmation ("Esta pestaña" with its audio) records exactly the player's sound.
- Link screen on a computer: the primary accent action is now "Grabar el vídeo", capturing this tab; "Micrófono" is the secondary fallback. When the video cannot play here (a not-embeddable card), the old "Escuchar" plus "Pestaña" (any other tab) remain.
- Link screen on a phone: "Escuchar" (microphone) plus a secondary "Archivo", the exact-audio route through a saved video; shared files go straight to trim, as before. One quiet line: "El vídeo suena por el altavoz: sube el volumen."
- Silence hint: when nothing arrives for 3 s while recording (level below about -57 dB), one quiet line replaces the hint area.
  - Tab: "No llega sonido. Comparte «Esta pestaña» con su audio."
  - Microphone: "No llega sonido. Sube el volumen del vídeo."
  - If the video itself has not started, "Toca el vídeo si no empieza" keeps priority.
- The YouTube wrapper now unmutes the player if YouTube falls back to muted playback, raises a volume under 50 to 100, and reports its sound state (data-muted on .share-link__stage).
- README "Limitaciones" updated: computer vs phone, and the saved-file route.

**Test lessons (in scripts/e2e-share.mjs comments):**
- Headless Chrome has no audio output, so any tab capture there is silent (even an in-page oscillator).
- --mute-audio silences the capture too.
- --use-fake-device-for-media-stream and --use-fake-ui-for-media-stream also FAKE getDisplayMedia ("Fake audio"). The desktop audio check therefore runs in a visible Chrome without fake flags, and the video's sound plays on the speakers for ~7 s.

ROUND 1 (the feature):
"Compartir con Pauta" is built and verified on the production build (service worker active). Files shared to Pauta go straight to Import (trim). Links open a screen that plays the video with the platform's OFFICIAL embed player while Pauta listens with the microphone. Nothing is downloaded: no server, no third-party resolver, only the official embeds and oEmbed.

- **Share target (Android, installed PWA):**
  - The manifest declares share_target (POST multipart/form-data to ./share-target, with title, text, url and files "media" for audio/*, video/* and 13 extensions).
  - public/share-target-sw.js is imported by the generated Workbox service worker. It stores the share (files as Blobs plus the texts) in Cache Storage ('pauta-share-v1') and answers 303 -> ./#/shared.
  - #/shared reads and clears that inbox, then: a media file is decoded into the capture store and opens /import (replace); a link, wherever it is (Android puts it in `text`), opens /link?url=…; anything else -> a calm toast and Home. Decode errors show the engine's Spanish message.
- **Link screen (/link):**
  - URL parsing covers watch?v=, youtu.be, /shorts/, /embed/, /live/, m., music., attribution links, t=/start=, scheme-less links, links inside Spanish share texts, emoji, «», parentheses and trailing punctuation, plus TikTok /@user/video/ID, /photo/ID, m.tiktok.com/v/ID.html, /embed/v2/ID, /player/v1/ID and the short forms vm., vt. and /t/.
  - YouTube: the IFrame API on youtube-nocookie.com (playsinline, Spanish UI). oEmbed (CORS) gives the title, the author and the real aspect ratio. 401/403 -> "Este vídeo solo se puede ver en YouTube", with the alternatives. Player errors 101/150/100 are handled the same way.
  - TikTok: full links open TikTok's official Embed Player (player/v1, postMessage play/pause). Short links are tried through TikTok's oEmbed (embed_product_id); when that fails -> "Este enlace corto de TikTok no se abre aquí", with "Archivo" (open the saved video) and "Escuchar".
  - Other sites -> "Este enlace no es de YouTube ni de TikTok". Offline and load failures get their own messages, with Reintentar.
  - One clear action, a big accent "Escuchar". It starts the microphone (same guarantees as RecordScreen: LiveBars, timer, auto-stop at the settings maximum, too-short takes refused, the microphone released on every exit) and plays the video in the same tap. If the video does not start (mobile autoplay rules), "Toca el vídeo si no empieza" appears. If the video ends, the take stops. Stop -> the normal /processing flow.
  - On a computer, a second "Pestaña" pill uses startRecording({ mode: 'tab' }) as it is (see requests). Microphone denied -> the engine's message plus "Reintentar".
- **New items:** source 'mic' (or 'tab'); title = the oEmbed title (cleaned of emoji and trailing hashtags) or defaultTitle('Enlace'); sourceName = the clean link. /processing is pushed, so cancelling it, or going Back from the new score, returns to the link.
- **Home:** a quiet "Enlace" pill (Link01) next to "Archivo" opens a PromptDialog to paste a link (iPhone and computers, where a web app cannot be a share target). Plain text without a link is refused with a toast.
- **Reuse:** the capture store, pipeline and Processing are reused through small additive changes: CaptureMeta {title, sourceName, retryBack}, an optional 4th parameter of setRecording, and optional title/sourceName in PipelineInput. Existing behaviour and tests are unchanged.
- **Tests and scripts:**
  - 71 new unit tests: link parsing with many real URL shapes and Spanish share texts, intake decisions, the Cache Storage inbox with a fake cache, oEmbed classification and parsing.
  - scripts/e2e-share.mjs: a real multipart form POST through the service worker, link states, the Home pill, a fake-microphone take on /link -> an item with sourceName = the link; --shots refreshes the screenshots.
  - scripts/e2e.mjs gained j1 (a POSTed file reaches Import) and j2 (a shared YouTube link opens /link).
- **README** "Limitaciones" updated.
- **Client feedback:** the 15:53 "share / capture" entry (approved at 16:00) is fully applied: files straight to the trim screen; TikTok/YouTube links through the official player, listened to by the microphone; never downloading; the share target on Android; the YouTube 401 fallback; the TikTok short-link test plus its fallback; iOS covered by "Enlace"; tab capture on a computer. The later entries (accuracy, sound, score) belong to other agents.

public_api_notes:
ROUND 2 ADDITIONS
- engine-audio: startRecording({ mode: 'tab', preferCurrentTab: true }) offers THIS tab first ("Esta pestaña") and allows picking it. Ignored in mic mode.
- useLinkTake:
  - start(mode, { currentTab = true }): currentTab false gives the plain picker (other tabs), used when the video cannot play in Pauta;
  - returns `silent` (true after SILENT_AFTER_MS = 3000 ms below SILENT_LEVEL = 0.05 while recording).
- players: EmbedCallbacks.onSound?({ muted, volume }) (YouTube).
- Selectors:
  - computer buttons 'Grabar el vídeo' (primary) / 'Micrófono'; phone buttons 'Escuchar' / 'Archivo';
  - .share-link__nudge carries the idle phone line or the silence hint;
  - .share-link__stage[data-muted].
- e2e-share: s (headless, silent fake microphone) and k (--audio, visible Chrome, real devices, --auto-accept-this-tab-capture). Never combine fake media flags with tab-capture checks.

ROUTES
- '/shared': intake.
  - Reads the service worker inbox once (StrictMode-safe), then replaces to /import, to /link?url=…, or to '/' with a toast.
  - Also accepts '?title=&text=&url=' (handy for a future Capacitor share extension) and '?error=1' (set by the service worker when it could not read the share).
- '/link?url=<encodeURIComponent(link)>': the player screen.
  - An invalid or missing url redirects Home.
  - Use linkPath(link) from src/features/share/links.ts to build the route.

SERVICE WORKER (public/share-target-sw.js, imported via workbox.importScripts; production build only)
- Handles POST <scope>share-target and answers 303 -> <scope>#/shared (or #/shared?error=1).
- Cache Storage 'pauta-share-v1':
  - <scope>__share/meta = JSON {v, at, title, text, url, files: [{key, name, type}]};
  - <scope>__share/file-N = the Blob (at most 4 files).
- The page reads it with takeSharedPayload() and deletes the cache; entries older than 15 min are ignored.
- Keep SHARE_CACHE and the key layout in sync between inbox.ts and the SW script.

EXPORTS (src/features/share)
- links.ts: parseLink(raw) -> SharedLink {platform 'youtube'|'tiktok'|'other', id, short, vertical, start?, url}, pickLink(...fields), findLinks(text), isPlayable, linkPath, platformName, parseStartTime, cleanTitle.
  - Canonical url: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ID[&t=Ns] or /shorts/ID; https://www.tiktok.com/@user/video/ID or /embed/v2/ID; short links as https://vm.tiktok.com/CODE/.
- intake.ts: decideIntake(payload) -> {kind: 'file'|'link'|'not-media'|'error'|'empty'}; isMediaFile; payloadFromParams; INTAKE_MESSAGES; MAX_SHARED_FILE_BYTES (750 MB, as on Home).
- inbox.ts: takeSharedPayload(storage?, now?) (never throws), SHARE_CACHE.
- oembed.ts: fetchOEmbed(link, signal?) -> {status: 'ok', title, author, ratio, id} | 'not-embeddable' | 'unavailable' | 'offline' | 'failed'; classifyStatus (401/403 not-embeddable, 400/404/410 unavailable); parseOEmbed; oEmbedUrl.
- players.ts: createEmbedPlayer(container, link, {onReady, onState, onError}) -> {play, pause, destroy}; loadYouTubeApi; tiktokPlayerUrl.
- Also: openMediaFile(file); useLinkTake({describe, onStart, onStop}); LinkPill.

CAPTURE (additive)
- store: meta: CaptureMeta | null = {title?, sourceName?, retryBack?}; setRecording(source, decoded, blob, meta?). Existing calls are unchanged; setFile and reset clear meta.
- pipeline: PipelineInput.title? overrides the default title; PipelineInput.sourceName? overrides the default sourceName.
- Processing: 'Reintentar' after 'No se detectaron notas' calls goBack() when meta.retryBack is set.

LINK TAKES
- source 'mic' (or 'tab' on a computer); sourceName = the canonical link; title = cleanTitle(oEmbed title) or defaultTitle('Enlace'). They appear under the library chip 'Grabaciones'.
- /link -> /processing is pushed (not replaced): cancelling Processing, or going Back from the new score, returns to the link.

SELECTORS (e2e)
- .share-link__stage carries:
  - data-platform = youtube|tiktok|other;
  - data-state = loading|ready|not-embeddable|unavailable|unsupported|short|offline|failed;
  - data-video = playing|paused|ended|buffering, from the official player.
  - The message card (.share-block__title) mounts only after the player card's exit animation: wait for it, not just for data-state.
- .share-player__frame iframe (youtube-nocookie.com/embed/ID or tiktok.com/player/v1/ID).
- .share-link__controls buttons 'Escuchar', 'Pestaña' (computers) and 'Archivo' (short-link state, first).
- Recording: button[aria-label="Detener"]; .share-meter__bars .ui-livebars__bar; .share-meter__elapsed.
- .share-link__message p + 'Reintentar' (microphone denied or error).
- .share-link__title, .share-link__meta, .share-link__nudge.
- Home: button 'Enlace' -> .ui-dialog__input + 'Abrir'.

SCRIPTS
- node scripts/e2e-share.mjs [--url http://localhost:5195/] [--build] [--shots] [--no-checks] [--headful] [--keep] [--verbose]
  - Serves dist/ itself on 5195 when nothing answers there; mocks need page.setBypassServiceWorker(true).
  - Background tabs get no animation frames in headless Chrome: bringToFront() before driving a page again.
- scripts/e2e.mjs: ids j1 and j2 (SKIP with --dev, since there is no service worker). A shared link check must wait until the embed iframe is gone before the next check (the offline check would otherwise catch its late requests).

known_issues:
ROUND 2, what only a real device can confirm:
- **Android phone (Chrome):** whether opening the microphone ducks, pauses or reroutes the embed's sound (audio focus / communication mode), and how much of the speaker reaches the microphone.
  - echoCancellation, noiseSuppression and autoGainControl are requested off, and Chrome reports them off in the track settings here.
  - The order is: the microphone opens first, then play() is called.
  - With a fake device here, the microphone take works (check g) and a silent one shows the hint (check s).
- **The real Chrome picker on a computer** (here auto-accepted by a switch): the user must leave «Compartir también el audio de la pestaña» on. If it is off, the app says 'No se compartió audio…' (NoAudioTrackError); if they share something silent, the 3 s hint appears.
- **Other desktop browsers:** Firefox and Safari have no tab-audio capture, so they keep the microphone ('Escuchar') with the volume line. Edge behaves like Chrome (not run here).
- Steps for the client:
  - En el ordenador (Chrome): abrir el enlace, tocar «Grabar el vídeo», elegir «Esta pestaña» con «Compartir también el audio de la pestaña» activado y aceptar; el vídeo empieza solo; parar al acabar.
  - En el móvil: subir el volumen y tocar «Escuchar»: Pauta oye el vídeo por el propio altavoz del móvil. Para el sonido exacto, si la plataforma deja guardar el vídeo, guardarlo y abrirlo con «Archivo» (o compartirlo con Pauta).

NOT VERIFIED HERE: the real Android share sheet.
- Not testable on this machine: WebAPK install, Pauta appearing in Android's share sheet, and the YouTube, TikTok and Gallery apps sending to it.
- What was verified instead: in headless Chrome on the production build, a real multipart/form-data form POST to ./share-target went through the service worker, i.e. the same request Chrome Android makes for a share. It landed on #/import with the file, and a POST whose text carried a YouTube link opened #/link.

NOT VERIFIED HERE: TikTok short links (vm.tiktok.com, vt.tiktok.com, tiktok.com/t/).
- From the browser, TikTok's oEmbed answered the first full-link request with CORS (200, embed_product_id).
- After a handful of test requests from this machine, every oEmbed call came back without CORS headers (net::ERR_FAILED; plain curl got '429 ratelimit triggered'). This held for full and short links alike, again ~40 min later, so whether TikTok's oEmbed resolves short links in a browser could not be established.
- The app tries oEmbed and otherwise shows the calm fallback: 'Este enlace corto de TikTok no se abre aquí' with 'Archivo' and 'Escuchar'.
- Full TikTok links do not need oEmbed: they open TikTok's official Embed Player directly (verified: the iframe loads).
- I did not spoof user agents or use any resolver service (hard rule).

NOT VERIFIED HERE: playback of the embeds with real sound.
- In headless Chrome, the YouTube IFrame API reported 'playing' during the take (data-video=playing). But sound output, the phone-speaker -> phone-microphone loop and its quality cannot be heard here: the fake microphone plays a fixture.
- On phones, autoplay rules may block playVideo() from our button. 'Toca el vídeo si no empieza' then appears, and the take keeps recording.
- TikTok play/pause through postMessage was not exercised. In Spain the TikTok player first shows its own cookie banner inside the video, and the test did not answer it. Users answer it once, inside TikTok's player.
iPhone: a PWA cannot be a share target. The Home 'Enlace' pill covers iPhone and computers. The embed and microphone together on iOS Safari were not tested on a device.
Recording a video from the phone's own speaker with its own microphone gives limited quality (small speaker, room sound). A saved file is better; the README says so.

YouTube not-embeddable: verified with a mocked oEmbed 401. Real YouTube error answers do carry CORS headers: the 400 for an unknown id was readable from the page. Videos blocked only inside the player (age or region) fall into the same message through onError 101/150.
Phones that installed Pauta before this build need the app refreshed to get the new share_target: reinstalling is the fastest way.
The share target exists only in the production build, where the service worker lives. On npm run dev, '/link' and 'Enlace' work, but POSTs to ./share-target do not, and e2e.mjs j1/j2 SKIP with --dev.

e2e.mjs was run with --url against my preview on port 5195, so its offline check used page.setOfflineMode. Its default mode (port 5189, server stopped for the offline check) was not run, to stay off the integration/final port. The share checks do not depend on that path.

CÓMO PROBARLO EN UN MÓVIL ANDROID (para el cliente):
1) Publicar la app con HTTPS: ejecutar npm run build y subir la carpeta dist/ a un hosting con HTTPS (por ejemplo, arrastrándola a https://app.netlify.com/drop, o GitHub Pages / Cloudflare Pages). Por HTTP o con la IP de la red local, Pauta no aparece en «Compartir»: Android solo instala la app de verdad desde HTTPS.
2) En el móvil, abrir esa dirección en Chrome y tocar el menú ⋮ > «Instalar aplicación» (o «Añadir a pantalla de inicio» > «Instalar»). Esperar unos segundos a que aparezca el icono de Pauta.
3) Abrir Pauta una vez desde el icono y dejar que cargue (así queda lista también sin conexión).
4) Archivo: en la Galería o en Archivos, elegir un vídeo o un audio de piano > Compartir > Pauta (la primera vez puede estar en «Más»). Debe abrirse la pantalla de recorte con ese archivo; tocar «Transcribir».
5) YouTube: en la app de YouTube, abrir un vídeo de piano > Compartir > Pauta. Se abre la pantalla del enlace con el reproductor oficial de YouTube. Subir el volumen, tocar «Escuchar» y permitir el micrófono: el vídeo empieza a sonar y Pauta escucha (si no arranca solo, tocar el vídeo). Al acabar, tocar el botón cuadrado de parar: Pauta procesa la grabación y abre la partitura con el título del vídeo.
6) TikTok: en TikTok, Compartir > «Más» (el panel de compartir de Android) > Pauta. Si el enlace corto no se puede abrir, Pauta lo dirá: entonces, en TikTok, tocar «Guardar vídeo» y, en Pauta, «Archivo» para elegirlo (o compartirlo desde la Galería). La primera vez, el reproductor de TikTok puede pedir que aceptes o rechaces sus cookies dentro del vídeo.
7) Sin compartir: en Inicio, tocar «Enlace», pegar el enlace y tocar «Abrir». Es lo que hay que usar en iPhone y en el ordenador.
8) Si Pauta no aparece en «Compartir»: comprobar que se instaló desde Chrome con HTTPS (no basta con un acceso directo), desinstalarla y volver a instalarla (la lista de compartir se lee al instalar) y, si sigue sin salir, reiniciar el móvil.
9) Para contarnos el resultado: qué paso falló, el modelo de móvil y una captura de pantalla.
